Package dev.turboism.sdk.plugin

Interface PluginContext

public interface PluginContext
Runtime context provided to a plugin during TurboismPlugin.init(PluginContext).

Optional services are discovered exclusively through services(): the directory reports which services the context installed and resolves them through PluginServiceDirectory.find(Class) / PluginServiceDirectory.require(Class). Every service also exposes an unavailable() sentinel and isAvailable() for probing (false only on the sentinel); plugins that prefer sentinel-driven degradation resolve with find(...).orElse(Service.unavailable()).

    • services

      default PluginServiceDirectory services()
      Returns the typed directory over this context's optional services — the canonical service-discovery surface. New optional services land on the directory and on PluginService; they do not gain a PluginContext accessor.

      The default resolves the context's remaining optional accessors (localization(), tasks(), hostReads(), storage(), scripts(), userFiles(), selectionQuery(), modelHierarchyQuery(), cubismRead(), modelObjects() and config()); the runtime installs a directory that covers every PluginService member.

      Returns:
      the service directory for this context; never null
